findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed that the tea dispensers in the customer area are sitting on the counters without their lids completely on, exposing the tea from potential contamination from above or from customers. CORRECTED: PIC was notified, and determined that the lids are warped, preventing them from lying flat on the dispenser. Staff have been provided metal hooks to clamp down the lids, but PIC determined that most of the lids did not have the hooks in use. PIC removed the tea dispensers from service until the lids could be fully secured or swapped with undamaged lids. Ensure that food on display is protected from contamination by effective means.
findings.citation_text: 3-306.11 Food Display. Except for nuts in the shell and whole, raw fruits and vegetables that are intended for hulling, peeling, or washing by the CONSUMER before consumption, FOOD on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of PACKAGING; counter, service line, or salad bar FOOD guards; display cases; or other effective means. [P]

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(C) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (C) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be kept in the original protective PACKAGE or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the follow nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment in need of more frequent cleaning to prevent an accumulation of ice, spills, and soil residues:
(i) the walk-in freezer has an accumulation of ice on the ceiling and on the electrical coil for the fans;
(ii) the bottom of the smoothie short cooler and McCafé short cooler have an accumulation of spills and moisture on the bottom shelves.
PIC was notified and these areas will be cleaned with increased frequency to prevent an accumulation of ice, spills, and soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(1) Observed that right handwashing sink in the men’s room was not working - when hands are moved under the sensor, a sound is heard but no water comes out. PIC was notified and clarified that this was a known issue and that the part is already on order. Inspector discussed with PIC putting an “out of order” sign on the sink until it is fixed to eliminate confusion for people washing hands to ensure that they wash their hands. The left handwashing sink is fully operational, so the men’s room still has handwashing available (free flowing water, soap, hand dryer).
(2) Observed the right soap dispenser in the women’s room was not working - when hands are moved under the sensor, no soap comes out. There is soap in the dispenser. PIC was notified and checked to make sure the dispenser was full and that there was a battery inside. PIC will change the battery. Inspector discussed with PIC putting an “out of order” sign on the soap dispenser until it is fixed to eliminate confusion for people washing hands to ensure that they wash their hands. The left soap dispenser is fully operational, so the women’s room still has handwashing available (free flowing water, soap, hand dryer).
Ensure that all equipment is maintained in good repair, and if an item is not functional, to effectively communicate that it is removed from service.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employee did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet after hand washing. The employee was educated when the action was observed. Management will be focusing on hand washing education for employees. Ensure that a barrier is always used to turn off the faucet to avoid re-contaminating clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed the prep line floors underneath equipment (ex. grills, deep fryers, heat lamp) have an accumulation of food debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil residues. Ensure that the floors underneath equipment on the food prep line are clean to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: The interior of the creamer machine on the frontline is observed with an accumulation of frost. Defrost the machine so the surfaces are easily cleanable. 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be cleaned as frequently as necessary to remain clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13:  The interior door of the creamer machine has a slight accumulation of soil. See that the creamer machine receives maintenance and cleaning attention so surfaces are observed in good repair and clean. 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
